sentences.quote: Zoe will assume the position of Chief Executive Designate on 1 September 2025 and will officially take on the role of Chief Executive on 17 November 2025.
sentences.text: Zoe Yujnovich, a former Shell and Rio Tinto executive, became chief executive on 17 November 2025, succeeding John Pettigrew after a board succession process.

sentences.quote: National Grid delivered FY2026 underlying EPS growth of 8% at constant currency, statutory EPS growth of 9%, and record capital investment of GBP 11.6 billion, supporting asset growth of 10.9%.
sentences.text: On delivery, FY2025/26 underlying EPS grew 8% at constant currency with record capital investment of 11.6 billion pounds and asset growth of 10.9%.

Capital allocation has been expansionary: a 2024 fully underwritten rights issue of about 7 billion pounds funded a 60 billion pound five-year plan, now at least 70 billion pounds over five years, alongside dividend growth of 3.8%, in line with CPIH.
She has since strengthened the executive team and created a growth forum to challenge capital decisions.

sentences.quote: - Extended and upgraded our Five-Year Financial Framework to 2030/31, with at least GBP 70 billion capital investment over the period
sentences.text: National Grid plc has committed to at least GBP 70 billion of capital investment over the five years to 2030/31, targeting around 10% asset growth CAGR and 8-10% underlying EPS CAGR from a 2025/26 baseline of 78.0p.
Around two-thirds of that programme is already covered by regulatory agreements, with about three-quarters of delivery mechanisms secured, supporting earnings visibility.
Earnings are anchored in regulated UK and US networks, with UK RAV up 12.8% and US rate base up 10.3% in 2025/26, giving regulated asset growth of 11.7%.

sentences.quote: The recommended final dividend per share is 32.14p, bringing the total dividend for the year to 48.49p, a 3.8% increase in line with UK CPIH inflation.
sentences.text: The total 2025/26 dividend was 48.49p, a 3.8% increase in line with UK CPIH inflation, with continued dividend per share growth in line with CPIH guided alongside the investment plan.
Portfolio simplification continues after GBP 2.8 billion of net cash proceeds from the divestments of National Grid Renewables and Grain LNG.

The total 2025/26 dividend was 48.49p, a 3.8% increase in line with UK CPIH inflation, with continued dividend per share growth in line with CPIH guided alongside the investment plan.
